inventory_binding: For each report decision whose final_action_admission.status is INPUT_ADMITTED, executor_admission.id and accepted_ns must exactly match retained runtime accepted event; terminal_ns comes from retained runtime terminal event for the same id. The resulting id list must equal accepted_program_inventory exactly.
baseline_rule: final_action_admission.action_validity.snapshot sequence; independently reread health/ammo from the exact retained PNG
scan_window: all exact observation captures with accepted_ns <= capture_ns <= terminal_ns for the admitted program, ordered by capture_ns then sequence
state_feedback_definition: earliest exact observation in the scan window where independently reconstructed health or ammo differs from the independently reconstructed baseline
stronger_task_effect_definition: plan-bound independently scored public kill/death/map-exit/progress transition with a retained timestamp; viewport pixel change, programmed input, terminal completion, and run-level final score are not sufficient
typed_signal_role: integrity cross-check only; retained typed health/ammo values cannot select the measured result
causality: not claimed; a post-admission health/ammo transition may be environmental or harmful

decision.RETAIN_FIRST_TASK_RELEVANT_FEEDBACK_SCOP: every admitted plan has independently reconstructed state_feedback and independently timestamped stronger task-effect feedback
decision.RETAIN_STATE_FEEDBACK_ONLY_SCHEMA_LIMIT: every admitted plan has independently reconstructed state_feedback, but at least one lacks independently timestamped stronger task-effect feedback
decision.SCHEMA_INSUFFICIENT_FIRST_USEFUL_FEEDBAC: at least one admitted plan lacks independently reconstructible state_feedback

retained_setup_failures.detail: execution_trace was incorrectly assumed to contain every admitted program lifecycle; no construction.json produced
analyzer produced an excluded construction output but old audit signature stopped before audit; not used as authoritative construction evidence
